title: Mystic Alchemist in Study
description: A blue-skinned alchemist wearing a red robe and golden crown stands in a purple arcane laboratory, holding a glowing orb connected by a red chain. The room is filled with shelves of glowing potions, floating eye symbols, open spellbooks, a red candle with wax drips, scales, and an ornate golden cabinet containing a large red eye-like artifact.
